$comment: Declarative registry of volatile state domains. Authority: docs/protocols/STATE_FRESHNESS_MANDATE.md. Private TNF domains degrade gracefully for public OSS consumers that cannot access them.

domains.title: Canonical tnf-monorepo main tip (internal when accessible)
claims: private canonical source is unavailable to this installation
domains.trap: A local HEAD, remembered commit, downstream publication SHA, or public clone is not proof of the private canonical main tip. Public OSS consumers may legitimately receive INTERNAL_UNAVAILABLE.

domains.title: Public open-runtime main tip
domains.trap: A reachable commit object is not proof that it is the public main tip. Only ref/heads/main establishes position; catastrophic history claims require corroboration.

domains.title: Private control-plane publication tip (internal when accessible)
claims: private publication state is unavailable to this installation
domains.trap: The control-plane repo is a private downstream extract. Public OSS consumers may legitimately receive INTERNAL_UNAVAILABLE; never treat that as a framework failure or infer private publication state.

domains.title: Public repo open PR numbers
domains.probe: gh pr list --repo whodaniel/The-New-Fuse --state open --limit 100 --json number --jq '[.[].number]|sort|tostring'
domains.trap: Closed PR numbers can be replaced by re-filed sync/publication PRs. Search for equivalent work before reporting that a publication change was lost.

domains.title: Public repo main protection rules
domains.trap: Repository rules can change independently. A remembered ruleset or a successful object upload does not prove public main protection or that a force-push occurred.

domains.title: Control-plane files absent from public repo
domains.probe: for f in packages/relay-core/src/master-clock.ts packages/relay-core/src/broker-agent.ts packages/agent-coordination; do gh api "repos/whodaniel/The-New-Fuse/contents/$f?ref=main" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "LEAKED:$f"; done; echo OK
domains.trap: Presence in tnf-monorepo or an export work tree is not publication. Assert a leak only from public-repo evidence at the published ref and corroborate a critical exposure before escalating.

domains.title: Product/repository map revision in this checkout
claims: this checkout classifies repo X as product Y
a repo is current/archived/publication-only in this map revision
domains.trap: Repository names and roles have changed historically. Use the machine-readable map shipped in the current checkout and distinguish it from inaccessible private source state.

domains.title: OSS/satellite application boundary revision in this checkout
claims: app X ships in the default OSS runtime
app X is a satellite/private surface
domains.trap: Being present under a historical apps/ path does not prove an app ships in the regular runtime. The machine-readable boundary in the current checkout is the packaging receipt.

domains.title: Local repository identity + work state
domains.probe: printf 'origin='; git remote get-url origin; printf 'head='; git rev-parse HEAD; printf 'branch='; git branch --show-current; printf 'dirty='; git status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' '
claims: this working tree points at repository X
domains.trap: A local folder name does not establish repository identity. Internal TNF development, owned publication targets, and external forks must be distinguished using the live remote and git state.

domains.title: Redis + relay reachability
domains.probe: ( timeout 5 redis-cli ping 2>/dev/null || echo REDIS_UNREACHABLE ) && ( curl -sf -m 5 http://127.0.0.1:3000/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo RELAY_OK || echo RELAY_DOWN )
domains.trap: A listening process or remembered boot message is not a round-trip health check. Probe the service before asserting current reachability.
